description: The widest and deepest dresser that fits a bedroom wall: the wall space less an inch each side, and the distance to the bed less 36 inches of clearance to open the drawers. Says whether a wide, standard dresser or a chest suits it. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

gap.description: From that wall to the bed or furniture it faces, in inches. Default 60.

wall.description: Wall space the dresser can take, in inches. Default 64.

name: dresser_size
title: Dresser size calculator
